verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents an Inference API that generates vector embeddings with models hosted on its own infrastructure, so ML engineers don't need to run their own embedding models. However, the evidence presents this as a separate API call. Nothing shows the index automatically embedding records at upsert or embedding raw text at query time. Missing for 10: evidence of index-integrated embedding at ingest and query time, a list of built-in or configurable model providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
